goodsServices.description: Downloadable electronic publications in the nature of toolkits, guides, manuals, templates and workbooks in the fields of business consultancy, retail, entrepreneurship and property; downloadable software and digital tools for use in lease negotiation, retail planning and business development; downloadable instructional materials; downloadable AI prompts and automation tools.

Printed publications; books; workbooks; manuals; printed instructional and teaching materials; stationery; printed educational materials in the fields of retail business, entrepreneurship and consultancy.

Business consultancy; commercial project management; business advisory services relating to retail location and lease negotiation; providing business support services to new and existing retail businesses; business consultancy in the field of shopfitting, store layout and operational setup; business information and advisory services provided via a website; marketing consultancy; provision of business data and reports.

Educational services; providing online training, workshops and courses in the field of retail, property, business development and artificial intelligence; publication of books and educational materials; development and delivery of training programmes and toolkits for entrepreneurs and retail businesses; providing non-downloadable instructional videos and digital content.

Development and provision of artificial intelligence tools; software as a service (SaaS) featuring AI assistants and automation tools for business support, lease management and project planning; providing temporary use of online non-downloadable software for use in business consultancy, retail development and property advice; AI-based business productivity platforms; design and development of proprietary digital tools and systems.
